name: deal-ai
description: Official Deal.ai MCP server: compare every US store's price for the same product with its price history, check whether a deal is real, ask Deal.ai's shopping agent what to buy, and watch prices with an e-mail when one drops.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches Deal.ai's product pages, live deals, buying guides and comparisons, with their latest prices.

tools.name: get_product_prices
tools.description: Every store's current price for one product, cheapest first, with a link to buy at each, and its price history.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: A product's description, specs, fact sheet from stores' pages, rating, photos, sizes and best price.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Two to four products side by side: specs, ratings and each one's best price.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Live deals by search, category, store, discount or price, biggest saving first.

tools.name: check_deal
tools.description: Checks a product link from any store, or a product's name, and the price offered: it finds the exact item at every big US store right now.

tools.name: get_deal_check
tools.description: The verdict (cheaper elsewhere, the lowest price, the only store), each store's price with a link, and whether the "was" price holds up.

tools.name: ask_deal_ai
tools.description: Asks Deal.ai's shopping agent, which researches the request and recommends picks with every store's price. Follow-up questions continue the same search.

tools.name: get_deal_ai_answer
tools.description: The agent's answer: its picks, why, where each is cheapest, and the search's page on Deal.ai.

tools.name: watch_price
tools.description: Saves a product to your Deal.ai wish list, which e-mails you when its price drops.

tools.name: list_watched
tools.description: The products you're watching, with their price now and when you saved them.

tools.name: stop_watching
tools.description: Removes a product from your wish list.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in with a free Deal.ai account; no API key.

examples.title: Best pick under a budget
examples.description: Ask the shopping agent what to buy
examples.prompt: Ask Deal.ai for the best noise cancelling headphones under $300.

examples.title: Check a deal
examples.description: See whether a price is really the lowest
examples.prompt: Is $199 a good price for AirPods Pro 3? Check it with Deal.ai.

examples.title: Compare products
examples.description: Specs, ratings and best prices side by side
examples.prompt: Compare the Sony WH-1000XM6 and Bose QuietComfort Ultra on Deal.ai.

examples.title: Watch a price
examples.description: Price history and a drop alert
examples.prompt: What's the lowest price Deal.ai has tracked for the Ninja Creami? Watch it for me.
